fences.rule: No raw color literals (hex, rgb/rgba, hsl/hsla) anywhere except apps/web/src/styles/tokens.css.
fences.note: 17 live violations at install (documentStylingExtensions.ts, admin/detail .module.css, SignaturePad.tsx). Graduate to block when cleared.

fences.rule: No border-left > 1px as an accent stripe.
fences.note: must distinguish accent from structural (R6 hard case).

fences.rule: No literal em dash in UI copy.
No width/height/top/left in transition or animation.
Header height = sidebar width = --shell-panel; no component invents a shell dimension.

rubrics.rubric: backdrop-filter:blur is detectable, but 'by default' needs intent — judge whether blur is load-bearing or decorative default.
Curves tokenized as --ease-*; judge whether motion 'feels like bounce/elastic' against the ease-out-exponential intent.
Judge for identical card grids / hero-metric template — gestalt sameness a regex can't catch.

signs.prose: No modals as the first thought — exhaust inline alternatives first.
Does this lead to craft, beauty, and care? The master rubric — human tier by definition. The system protects attention for THIS by walling everything below it.

names.contentView: the middle box — the only region that changes per route (was: mainContent)
names.bodyZone: the horizontal band holding Sidebar + main (was: contentZone) — renamed to kill the contentZone/contentView collision flagged in first compile
names.resolved_collision: first compile flagged mainContent vs contentZone as a real vocabulary collision; resolved to contentView (route mount) + bodyZone (band).
